bugs.summary: The new glued-sentinel strip is skipped when the start-at-0 standing token itself ends with "...", so a without-file re-fold of such a token longer than 160 chars still appends the token again instead of keeping it once.
bugs.evidence: src/session/compaction-handoff.ts:160-163 `if (goal.endsWith(SPINE_CUT_SENTINEL) && !token.endsWith(SPINE_CUT_SENTINEL))`; cutSpineGoal (:197-199) returns `${kept}${SPINE_CUT_SENTINEL}` for any start-at-0 token, so a token ending in "..." becomes token+"..." in Goal and falls through to the append at :171-175. Fix PR #1249 drops the `!token.endsWith(...)` guard (condition becomes `if (goal.endsWith(SPINE_CUT_SENTINEL))`) and adds a test with token `FILES_DONE=...end...` asserting one Output token after two re-folds.

rejected.was: model cluster (bake-off 11 + round 2 ~14 prompts, 156-170): new strip branch removes an operator-authored trailing ellipsis / bypasses trailingEllipsisIsStandingToken
rejected.why: Unreachable: Output tokens are harvested from the same spine.goal as the Goal line (renderHandoffSpine :871-874), so an operator-written `FILES_DONE=a.ts...` yields Output token `FILES_DONE=a.ts...`, which ends with the sentinel (guard :162 skips) and is already standing (:155 returns). Prose after a token keeps the token standing in goal (:155). The prefix-only match happens only when the sentinel is glued to the token by cutSpineGoal.
